events.text: The Battle of the Burning was a short but bloody conflict that raged in Wealdath of Tethyr circa 1350 DR.
Elminster Aumar retired from adventuring in the town of Shadowdale.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 140

events.text: Around 1350 DR, the king of Silla ordered "nameless ones" to kidnap the teenaged children of Meo Yungdo, a noble of Xai Chung.
Around 1350 DR, the king of Silla ordered "nameless ones" (ninja) to kidnap the teenaged children of Meo Yungdo, a noble of Xai Chung.
The Battle of Bryn Shander was fought between the barbarian tribes of Icewind Dale and the defenders of the Ten Towns in the Year of the Crown, 1351 DR.

Days before his coronation, Prince Soarimbrar and his royal retinue were slain by assassins while riding through the Easting Coast. While the prince's infant-nephew Imphras V was named as the future king, Queen-regent Sambryl and the Lords of Imphras II maintained stewardship of Impiltur's governance.
In 1351 DR, Heafstaag and his group of barbarians fail to conquer the settlement of Termalaine in their massive sweep of the Ten-Towns.
Theremen Ulath - A fair and just man who exercised the minimum amount of authority needed over Deepingdale.
In the Year of the Crown, 1351 DR, the king's treasury and armory were robbed—by magic, some said.
In the Year of the Dragon, 1352 DR, a young girl named Erixitl destined to become the herald of the Feathered God Qotal, was kept from traveling with her friends to the town of Cordotl.
In the Year of the Dragon, 1352 DR, Gondegal, also known as "The Usurper King" and "The Lost King", attempted to establish a separate kingdom centred on the city of Arabel.

Gondegal, also known as the "Lost King", attempted to establish a kingdom centered in the city of Arabel after a lightning campaign of conquest and pillage through many Cormyrian towns and villages. He was overthrown after only eight days on his Arabellan "throne" by an allied army composed of forces from Tilverton, Sembia and Daggerdale along with the Purple Dragons, led by king Azoun IV.

In the Year of the Dragon, 1352 DR, a new High Priest of the Tower of Tempus, the High Priest and Champion Rampant of Tempus Taeron, took office and promptly refused to pay the Shadowmasters' protection racket.
Circa 1353 DR, the then Marcrown of Turmish hired bounty hunters to find the notorious thief Tasso.
Randal Morn killed Malyk, the Zhent-installed ruler of Daggerdale. Dalesfolk from the region joined Randal in his revolution against the foreign conquerors.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 140

events.text: Lord Dagus of Olafstaad sailed for the Nelanther Isles with a small army of sixty warriors.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: The Great Fires was a disastrous even that took place in 1355 DR and ravaged the Shining Plains region of the Vilhon Reach.
By 1355 DR, the retreat from former Cormanthyr reached its peak; nearly 90% of the elven inhabitants departed in this way, heading for Evermeet or Evereska.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 140

src.title: History of Cormanthyr
src.section: The Interim Years and the Retreat

events.text: Malkizid returned to Faerûn and takes leadership over the fiends infesting the city.

In the Year of the Harp, 1355 DR, Amril Zoar, member of the exiled Zoar family, killed two Masked Lords of the city, Lady Tamaeril Bladesemmer and Lord Resengar the Whitebeard and gravely wounded Lord Piergeiron.
The Zhentarim enthralled the village of Snowmantle, transforming it into a labor camp to support their logging efforts in the Border Forest.
cites: Ruins of Zhentil Keep: Adventure Book, с. 3

events.text: In the Year of the Harp, 1355 DR, Zhent forces betrayed the allies they forged after Mulmaster's defeat and utilized poison and dark magic to enact a treacherous takeover of the Citadel of the Raven.
cites: Ruins of Zhentil Keep: Campaign Book, с. 29

events.text: In Year of the Harp, 1355 DR, Helm Dwarf-Friend became the sixth Ruling Master of Sundabar after the previous Master died defending the city from orcs.
The battle of Daledrop was a battle fought the dwarves of Clan Battlehammer and a war party serving Akar Kessell in 1356 DR.
The battle of Icewind Dale was a battle fought between the defenders of the Ten Towns in Icewind Dale and the conquering forces of Akar Kessell in the Year of the Worm, 1356 DR.
The First Dragonspear War was an armed conflict between the allied armies of Baldur's Gate and Waterdeep, and the devils that dwelled within Dragonspear Castle.
In 1356 DR, Lord Lashan Aumersair of Scardale invaded and conquered Harrowdale in the second inter-dale war, but his forces were soon defeated.
Cormyr, the Dalelands and other cities of the Moonsea were devastated by a Flight of Dragons.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 140

events.text: Cormyr seized Tilverton and installed a Lady Regent, seeking to expand its influence in the Dales.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 140

events.text: Princess Alusair Nacacia ran away from the royal palace.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 140

events.text: Queen Yenandra, who is suffering in her old age, allows herself to be transformed into a spectral guard by her daughter Hasifir and drow sorcerers
The Flight of the Dragons ripped through the Dalelands and the Moonsea regions, cutting out a swath of destruction. While the Cult claimed credit for the dragons' rage, the true cause was unknown.

src.title: History of the Cult of the Dragon

events.text: The Second inter-dale war occurred after the Lord of Scardale, Lashan Aumersair attempted to unite all of the Dalelands under one banner. His forces managed to defeat Featherdale, Battledale and Harrowdale but were defeated in Mistledale.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition, с. 118

events.text: To keep a check on Scardale's power, a united coalition force of Dalesfolk from Mistledale, Deepingdale and Shadowdale as well as martial forces and delegates from Cormyr, Hillsfar, Sembia and even Zhentil Keep began occupying, and governing the dale from its capital, Scardale Town.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition, с. 118

events.text: Anastra Syluné Silverhand died while protecting Shadowdale from a red dragon during the Flight of Dragons.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 140

events.text: In 1356 DR, a Kuong temple sohei tried to assassinate the great Seng wu jen Hueng, master of a school of magic in the town of Deikhou.
In 1356 DR, a Kuong temple sohei attempted to assassinate the great Seng wu jen Hueng, master of a school in Deikhou that trained wu jen in the art of magic.
In the Year of the Worm, 1356 DR, Melvaunt discovered that one of its own, Lyran Nanther, was a lieutenant of the Zhentarim agent Jyordhan after having launched a failed invasion of Shadowdale.
In the same year of 1356 DR, these aligned forces installed a new government in Scardale, a provisional Lordship held by the cleric Myrian Beechwood.
The second inter-dale war occurred in 1356 DR when Lord Lashan Aumersair of Scardale invaded a number of other dales.
In 2606 (1356 DR), a portal was said to have opened in the southwestern mountains through which returned some of the descendants of those who were forced to flee to Oerth a century prior.
During the First Dragonspear War of the Year of the Worm, 1356 DR, the devil-led armies of Dragonspear Castle ransacked Triboar.
The Battle of Hawa was a naval conflict that occurred between the mamluk fleet from Qudra and the corsairs of Hawa in 1357 DR.
The First Battle of Shadowdale was a battle fought in Shadowdale, in the Dalelands, in 1357 DR, between the defending forces of the Dalelands, and forces of Lyran Nanther.
Circa 1357 DR a fleet of the mamluks of Qudra tried to take control of the city.

The Sembian cell of the Cult pursued a young Daleswoman from Deepingdale, by the name of Shandril Shessair, in an effort to understand and obtain her seemingly unique magical power known as spellfire. The Cult agents, who were acting against both members of the Zhentarim and the young woman's allies such as the Knights of Myth Drannor, some Harpers members and even the Seven Sisters.

src.title: History of the Cult of the Dragon

events.text: This quest for power had the Cult agents traveling from the Dalelands all the way into the Western Heartlands and claim several casualties. Among the dracoliches lost in this conflict were Rauglothgor, Aghazstamn and even the mighty Shargrailar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142

src.title: History of the Cult of the Dragon

events.text: Chansreena Alabhansree Alanasker of Ormpur eloped with her lover, the pirate Cairak Redbeard to the Moonshae Isles, taking several magic weapons and a large quantity of saffron with her to ensure a comfortable life.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142

events.text: By 1357 DR, Koguryo was governed by an array of petty lords, who held allegiance to King Wanang Sun but might struggle for their independence when he passed on.
cites: Kara-Tur: The Eastern Realms: Volume II, с. 122

events.text: By 1357 DR, Koryo was at war with Kozakura.

In the Year of the Prince, 1357 DR, Chessenta was once again wracked by warfare, with Airspur, Luthcheq, and Soorenar allied against Cimbar, but Akanax and Mordulkin had yet to join their traditional ally.
During the Year of the Prince, 1357 DR, King Theris announced to his subjects that he would soon be dying.
By 1357 DR, the Thultyrl of Procampur was the young Rendeth of the Royal Blood, while the position of Hamayarch was held by Alamondh.
By the Year of the Prince, 1357 DR, Reth was under the control of Chessenta with a separatist movement active that sought to join with the city's old masters – Chondath.
Circa the Year of the Prince, 1357 DR, Reth was struggling with separatist sentiments as a significant portion of the population sought to leave Chessenta and become part of Chondath.
In 1357 DR, the whole island of Saishu was quarantined after an outbreak of the ivory plague.

The Salamander War, sometimes called the Salamander Wars, was a disasterous yearlong conflict waged by Thay in the Year of the Prince, 1357 DR, first alongside and then against an army of salamanders that they themselves had summoned.
By 1357 DR, Silla was governed by an array of petty lords, who held allegiance to King Wanang Sun but might struggle for their independence when he passed on.
cites: Kara-Tur: The Eastern Realms: Volume II, с. 121–122

events.text: By the Year of the Prince, 1357 DR, Silverymoon, as well as Sundabar and Citadel Adbar, had attacked the demons of Hellgate Keep, failed to reclaim the city, and faced direct offensives from the ghoul-hold themselves.
In the Year of the Prince, 1357 DR, Soorenar allied with Airspur to attack Cimbar, set on dividing the city between them, although Soorenar began to fare poorly in this war.
In the Year of the Prince, 1357 DR, Dabron Sashenstar of Baldur's Gate embarked on a voyage to Sossal.
In 1357 DR, the tharchion of Lapendrar Hargrid Tenslayer joined forces with the zulkirs of evocation and conjuration in what was the then-most-ambitious plan of conquest ever undertaken in Thay.
Bhaal was slain by the mortal Cyric with the sword Godsbane, which was an avatar of the god Mask.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition, с. 264
Ruins of Zhentil Keep: Campaign Book, с. 25–26,118

events.text: In 1358 DR, the Mayor of Amah at the time - Pachipol, participated in a meeting of leaders of both Chondath and Turmish to discuss the menace of the arcanaloth Yrkhetep.
cites: Swords of the Iron Legion, с. 52

events.text: During the Time of Troubles in the Year of Shadows, 1358 DR, aggressive magical currents appeared in As'arem, and strangled Finar Ri'ala'vor.
The Battle of Ascore was a conflict between the expansionist Zhentarim and the defending heroes of the Savage Frontier.

The Battle of Demarch's Fall was a battle fought in the Halls of Demarch beneath the city of Tantras in the Vast between rival factions of Demarch's Alliance, an alliance between beguilers who served Leira and those who served Mask.

The Battle of Keeper's Dale was a short war fought in the Silver Marches in the autumn of the Year of Shadows, 1358 DR by Clan Battlehammer dwarves of Mithral Hall and their allies in the Silver Marches against the drow of Menzoberranzan and their slave army of humanoids.
In the Year of Shadows, 1358 DR, the High Sun riot erupted in Berdusk due to food shortages in the city.
During the Time of Troubles, in the Year of Shadows, 1358 DR, refugees from Hlintar and other chaos-stricken areas fled to Calaunt, as well as Ravens Bluff, and Tantras.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142

events.text: The Goblin Wars were a series of conflicts fought in the kingdom of Erlkazar against invading goblins in 1358 DR.
During the Time of Troubles in the Year of Shadows, 1358 DR, a significant temple to Loviatar in Turmish was destroyed.
During the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR, the god Garagos manifested in Westgate and went on a rampage.

During the Time of Troubles the manifestation of the god Bane marched from Zhentil Keep to Shadowdale in search of the Celestial Stairway that had appeared at Morningdawn Hall. The forces of the evil god were turned away at great loss of life.
Zhents assaulted the High Castle through a series of portals.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition, с. 132

events.text: The fledgling wizard Keane arrives in Callidyrr to join the Council of Sorcerers.
The Time of Troubles occurs, beginning the Era of Upheaval.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142

events.text: After Bane and Myrkul attempted to steal the Tablets of Fate from Lord Ao, the gods were struck down from the heavens and forced to walk Toril in their avatar forms. Bane arrived in the Black Altar, his dedicated temple in Zhentil Keep, in an event known to the keep's people as the Arrival. After having his Zhent begin work on the creation of a new colossal body, made from arcane magic and black glass, he had the Banite priest Fzoul Chembryl and Manshoon's apprentice Sememmon work together, to their mutual displeasure, to assault the Twisted Tower of Ashaba in Shadowdale so that he could could
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition, с. 271
Ruins of Zhentil Keep: Campaign Book, с. 21
Ruins of Zhentil Keep: Campaign Book, с. 20

events.text: Eleasis 13: The colossal avatar of Bane was destroyed in an epic battle with Torm over the city of Tantras.
cites: Ruins of Zhentil Keep: Campaign Book, с. 21

events.text: These events, along with few other developments would cause great changes within the Zhentarim. Iyachtu Xvim, the divine son of Bane, and the newly-ascended deity Cyric, who took on his divine portfolio, became the focus of worship for a great number of the members of the Zhentarim. The Cyricist temple, called the Circle of Darkness was formed in Zhentil Keep. The spirit of Iyachtu, which was released from his avatar upon its destruction, was sealed beneath the Keep, full of anger that it was Cyric, not himself, who claimed his father's divine power. Many of Bane's followers converted to the w
cites: Ruins of Zhentil Keep: Campaign Book, с. 21

events.text: In celebration, the city marched upon Mithral Hall in 1358 DR, viciously attacking the dwarfhold in what would be known as the Battle of Keeper's Dale.
In 1358 DR, during the events of the Time of Troubles, the Riders of Mistledale were even able to rebuff an army from Zhentil Keep.
In Eleint of the Year of Shadows, 1358 DR, the town came under the first of several attacks from the Uthgardt Griffon Tribe.

In 1358 DR, Pil'it'ith and his followers secretly approached the minions of the Mulhorandi deity Set and offered to help Set in binding their god Sseth, who had gone silent, into eternal slumber, in exchange for divine aid in their battle against the khaastas.
In the Year of Shadows, 1358 DR, Orlumbor was besieged in a surprise naval attack by ships that flew the flags of Waterdeep.
During the Time of Troubles, in the Year of Shadows, 1358 DR, many wealthy merchants of Procampur fled to their country houses in the neighboring town of Maerstar.
During the Time of Troubles, in the Year of Shadows, 1358 DR, dead-magic zones sprung up around the land and the Wychlaran had trouble contacting the spirits.
The Roar of Shadows was a titanic conflict between the avatars of Nobanion, the King of Lions, and Malar, the Beastlord, during the Time of Troubles.

The second battle of Shadowdale (often referred to as simply the battle of Shadowdale) was a battle fought in Shadowdale within the Dalelands in 1358 DR, between the defending forces of the Dalelands, and troops from Zhentil Keep, led by Bane.
During the Time of Troubles, in the Year of Shadows, 1358 DR, skeletons rose from their graves to take over the town of Hlintar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142

events.text: The Time of Troubles was a cataclysmic time period in the chronology of Faerûn.
During the Time of Troubles, in the Year of Shadows, 1358 DR, the god Talos the Destroyer visited Tsurlagol.

In the Year of Shadows, 1358 DR, during the Time of Troubles, the avatar of the duergar god Deep Duerra appeared in Underspires in the form of the "Queen Mother", serving as regent until War King Olorn Ridaugaur came of age.

The Bloodstone Wars were a series of battles waged during the Year of the Serpent, 1359 DR, in Damara between the Barony of Bloodstone and the various puppet duchies and baronies of Zhengyi the Witch-King.

In the Year of the Serpent, 1359 DR, Dashard used this network to rally public sentiment against Gareth Dragonsbane, the new ruler of the Barony of Bloodstone, and plotted to invade the small barony in order to seize control of the hugely productive Bloodstone Mines.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 144

events.text: Gauntather the Dark Druid and the priests of the Risen Cult of Bane arrived in the Moonshaes. Their goal was to spread chaos and fear among the Ffolk as well as battle the druids. They used brigands and undead creatures to accomplish their goals.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: In the Year of the Serpent, 1359 DR, Mount Ugruth came to life once again.
In 1359 DR, during the Time of Troubles, House Oblodra, the Third House, aspired to become the First House of Menzoberranzan.

In the Year of the Serpent, 1359 DR, Snowdown was gripped by a slew of mysterious bandit raids by the "Black Dwarf", who would plunder, raid, and disappear, leaving a signature mark of a black axe painted on a yellow shield left in the wreckage.
In the following year, the Year of the Turret, 1360 DR, Yamun Khahan was killed and his armies defeated by allied forces under the command of King Azoun Obarskyr IV of Cormyr.
The Battle at the Bar was a fight that broke out in the common room of the Whistling Wizard inn sometime around the Year of the Turret, 1360 DR.
The Battle of the Chasm was one of the early engagements between the Bedine tribes of Anauroch and the Zhentilar soldiers that sought to take control of the desert for their Zhentarim masters.
The Battle of the Fissures was the penultimate conflict between the tribes of the Bedine and the combined forces of the Zhentarim and their asabi mercenaries.

In Tarsakh of the Year of the Turret, 1360 DR, Earthfast was the first to respond via letter to King Azoun IV's call for a crusade against the Tuigan Horde, with King Torg committing 2000 dwarven soldiers to the Army of the Alliance.
King Azoun IV led a unified army against the Tuigan Horde in Thesk, defeating them at Phsant. King Azoun IV then slew Yamun Khahan in single combat.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 144

events.text: The saurials began to appear in abandoned Tarkhaldale.

Severe weather conditions hit the Moonshaes and would last for the next five years. The islands contended with blizzards, drought, powerful storms, and even hurricanes. The adverse weather was caused by Talos after his acolytes were paid by the traitorous Earl Angus Blackstone of Fairheight to create a food shortage.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: The Second Unhuman War was a conflict between elves and the scro that spread over several crystal spheres of the Prime Material plane in the mid-14th century DR.
In the Year of the Turret, 1360 DR Telflamm became an integral part of the war between the invading Tuigan Horde and the united armies of Faerûn under the command of King Azoun Obarskyr IV.
In 1360 DR, the Tuigan Horde, led by Horselord Yamun Khahan invaded Faerûn from the Hordelands in the east.
The Banedeath, also known as the First Banedeath, was the systematic purging of the Banite faith from the city of Zhentil Keep in 1361 DR.
The First Battle of Ulatos was a battle fought in 1361 DR between the Golden Legion from Amn and the Payit of Ulatos.
In the Year of Maidens, 1361 DR, stories of the newly discovered Maztica and rumors of a Harper assassin spread throughout Waterdeep.

Four Cult archmages traveled to Silverymoon and barraged the town with a flurry of spells to draw out Alustriel Silverhand, Sammaster's former companion and lover centuries before. She managed to defend herself and the town for some time with the help of Taern Hornblade and the Spellguard.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146

src.title: History of the Cult of the Dragon

events.text: The battle almost turned in favor of the Cult, when they let loose a dracolich upon the town's southern walls. However the Cult forces were finally rebuffed with the arrival of Laeral Silverhand, Alustriel's sister, and Khelben "Blackstaff" Arunsun.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146

src.title: History of the Cult of the Dragon

events.text: A huge column of flame shot down from a dark cloud hanging over the Moonsea and ignited the Black Altar. This was considered a divine sign from among the followers of Cyric.
cites: Ruins of Zhentil Keep: Campaign Book, с. 21

events.text: In the Year of Maidens, 1361 DR, the Red Wizard Marek Rymüt was engaged in a breeding program to produce the mutant offspring of a male black dragon and female fire drakes, which he called black firedrakes, in a nursery underneath the second quarter of Innarlith.
In the Year of Maidens, 1361 DR, the Golden Legion from Amn arrived in Maztica.
In 1361 DR, the Golden Legion from Amn arrived in Maztica.
In 1361 DR, the Golden Legion mercenary company from Amn arrived in Ulatos and conquered the city.
By the Year of the Helm, 1362 DR, as the war between the Golden Legion and the bloodthirsty Nexala raged, the town of Cordotl was thought to have been decimated and deserted.
By Marpenoth of the Year of the Helm, 1362 DR, the Pommarch, Namarch, and Meisarch had all killed each other in an event historians would refer to as the Council Schism.
In the years following Mintar's takeover by Teldorn Darkhope and his Knights of the Black Gauntlet in 1362 DR, many fled east from the city-state to seek refuge in Saelmur.
cites: Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 156

events.text: At the young age of 13, Prince Imphras V died as a result of a wasting disease. His five-year-old brother, Imbrar II was named as the rightful heir to the throne.
In autumn of the Year of the Wyvern, 1363 DR, Lord Bron disappeared from within the city and the Zhentarim moved swiftly to supplant him with their own leader, Lord Ravendas.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146

events.text: The Second Dragonspear War was a series of conflicts that took place in the Year of the Wyvern, 1363 DR, between the rampaging Hordes of Dragonspear and several armies united in defense.
In 1363 DR, just three years after the death of his father the Great Khan Yamun Khahan, Hubadai declared himself Khahan and founded the empire of Yaïmmunahar.
The conflict between the Zhentarim and the Sembian cell of the Cult escalated as cult members began openly attacking Zhent caravans and attempted to take over their trade routes.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146

src.title: History of the Cult of the Dragon

events.text: After years of battle with the territorial white wyrm Arveiaturace, the elder topaz dragon Itharagh underwent the process to become a dracolich.

src.title: History of the Cult of the Dragon

events.text: In Year of the Wave, 1364 DR, Iriador Wintermist brings a hailstorm to Sundabar to avenge the loss of the barding colleges in Faerun.
In the Year of the Wave, 1364 DR, Telflamm meekly welcomed the pirates of the Sharkjaws flotilla under Evgruth the Red's command and the significant wealth they brought along.
In the Year of the Wave, 1364 DR Borlin, blood of Ghellin, mustered a dwarf army known as the Mithril Legion to reclaim Tethyamar for the Iron House, but the force was defeated.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 147

events.text: In the Year of the Sword, 1365 DR, an army masquerading as the forces of Callidyrr attacked settlements in southern Gnarhelm in an effort to provoke a war between the Northlanders and the Ffolk.

The Sembian cell of the Cult managed to convince Malygris, an elder blue dragon of Anauroch, to undergo the process to become a dracolich. After becoming undead, Malygris destroyed the Suzerain of blue dragons Sussethilasis and supplanted his rule over the 20 or so blue dragons in the desert.

src.title: History of the Cult of the Dragon

events.text: Gotha, the red dracolich, was destroyed by Alicia Kendrick when her body was taken over to serve as an avatar of the Earthmother Chauntea.

src.title: History of the Cult of the Dragon

events.text: Robyn Kendrick sensed the imminent return of the Earthmother to the Moonshaes. Angered by her return, Talos attempted to throw the islands into chaos by turning the Ffolk and Northlanders against each other. To achieve this goal, Talos recruited an army of pirates, sahuagin from Kressilacc and the dracolich Gotha.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: High King Tristan Kendrick traveled to Amn in a galleon to negotiate a trade deal. He was seeking large quantities of grain to feed the hungry population of his realms. While making the return voyage, his ship was captured by the sea troll king Krell-Bane and brought to Kyrasti. His left hand was cut off and delivered to his wife, the High Queen Robyn.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: Ityak-Ortheel was released by Malar in Myrloch Vale attacked the elven kingdom of Synnoria.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: In exchange for favors from Talos, Angus Blackstone was tasked with betraying the High King. His treachery was exposed and the Earl was executed. His son, Hanrold Blackstone became the new Earl.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: The dwarven town of Cambro was sacked by firbolgs led by Thurgol. Trolls joined his army as it marched north.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: Princess Deirdre Kendrick aided in the release of the avatar of Grond Peaksmasher. She was corrupted by Talos and was later killed by her sister Alicia Kendrick.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: High King Tristan Kendrick abdicated his claim to the throne to be with his wife, Queen Robyn. She had left the capital to live in Myrloch Vale in order to commune with the Earthmother. Alicia Kendrick was now High Queen.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: In the Year of the Sword, 1365 DR, another threat emerged, as the Great Bone Wyrm Alasklerbanbastos and his coterie of young chromatic dragons swooped down from the Riders to the Sky and laid claim to all the lands of Threskel and northeastern Chessenta—including Mordulkin.

In truth the tournament was sabotaged by Kabbarath Telthaug, that Imperceptor of Bane that installed himself as the Regent of Mourktar until the Year of the Sword, 1365 DR, when rule of the city was forcibly shared with three younger blue dragons, by decree of Alasklerbanbastos, ruler of Threskel.
In the Year of the Sword, 1365 DR, the Great Bone Wyrm claimed dominion over all of Threskel, and bequeathed each of its cities to his chromatic dragon followers as vassal-states.
In the Year of the Staff, 1366 DR, King Valon died, appointing his son Korox, the leader of Elestam's Crusaders, to succeed him.
In the Year of the Staff, 1366 DR, when Princess Brianna was grown, an emissary of the ogres visited his castle to remind him of his dark deal.
Keane married High Queen Alicia, becoming the new High King.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: Prince Brandon Olafsson became the new king of Gnarhelm.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: Pilgrimages to druid groves all over the Moonshaes increased.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: The Andonian Games were some form of grand competition that was sporadically held in the city of Ravens Bluff over the course of the mid-to-late 14th century DR.
In Mirtul of the Year of the Shield, 1367 DR, drow were spotted lurking on the streets at night.
Haresk Malorn: The High Councilor was known as a wise and honest man.
Sister Alena: A young priestess of Chauntea from the Abbey of the Golden Sheaf.
Dumic the Red: This loud and brash rancher hailed from the western region of the dale.
Targen Holdfast: A woodsman and retired adventurer.
Ulwen Sharin: The graceful head of the Sharin freehold.
Around 1367 DR, Grima al-Auni, the hill giant cleric of Kor fought against an increasing number of Istishia cultists in the city.
cites: Land of Fate: Fortunes and Fates, с. 35

events.text: High Queen Alicia sent an emissary to Open Lord Piergeiron Paladinson of Waterdeep to establish an embassy and to prepare for an official visit, which would be her first time setting foot on the mainland.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 2nd edition (revised): Running the Realms, с. 21–22

events.text: Donalbain founds the bardic college of Broadleaf Lodge on Snowdown.
By the Year of the Shield, 1367 DR, the Cult of the Dragon usurped the majority of Hlondeth's black market and slavery operations.
Around 1367 DR, active members of the Society of Shifting Sands were searching the ruins of this empire for magical artifacts.
In the Year of the Shield, 1367 DR, a wizard named Shoudra Stargleam managed to establish herself as a new temporal power in the city calling herself Sceptrana.
Circa the Year of the Shield, 1367 DR, Marsembian spice trade saw a significant decrease.
Circa the Year of the Shield, 1367 DR, Phlan was considered to be an exciting place that was well in the highs of its great reconstruction.
Early in the Year of the Shield, 1367 DR, priests of Torm ran Calispar Delgorth, a priest of Talona, out of Procampur.
By Marpenoth of 1367 DR, Procampur was struck by the featherlung plague, which killed hundreds of people, particularly in the District of the Poor.

The Reclamation Wars, also known as the Tethyrian Civil War, was a series of conflicts that centered around Zaranda Star, the Countess of Morninggold, and her efforts to unite the kingdom of Tethyr during the last years of the Tethyrian Interregnum of the mid-14th century DR.
By 1367 DR, Conoptora Billon was serving as the Ven's Voice.
By 1367 DR, warnings circulated that the gray orcs of the Dustwall Mountains were gathering in preparation for a major assault or raids into Ulgarth.
Cyricists killed Kurth Dracomore, a devout worshiper of Bane and sent his to Fzoul Chembryl.

The church of Cyric began the Second Banedeath in the Zhentarim-held cities of Yûlash, Darkhold, Teshwave, Zhentil Keep and the Citadel of the Raven. They cleansed the strongholds of any non-Cyricist priests.
In the Year of the Banner, 1368 DR, the Bhaalspawn Sarevok Anchev orchestrated a major conspiracy to send the city to war with Amn.

In the Year of the Banner, 1368 DR, Queen Rosalind of Edenvale ordered Atreus Eleint and Yago expelled from her kingdom, with an honor guard to escort them to the Doegan Shores and put on the first ship to the Sword Coast.

In the Year of the Banner, 1368 DR, Atreus Eleint of Erlkazar in west Faerûn undertook an expedition to the Utter East to find the fabled realm of Langdarma, passing through Edenvale, where they were joined by Rishi Saubhari.
In 1368 DR, Volo was visiting the city of Elturel once again.
Read aloud the True Life of Cyric, which directly caused the fall of Zhentil Keep.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 149

events.text: In Myrloch Vale, the wardens of the druid groves started to vanish after receiving summons to enter the moonwells.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: Nightal 28-30: Fzoul Chembryl read aloud from the True Life of Cyric, revealing the god's betrayal of his followers, slew Xeno Mirrormane and fled the Cyricist-led assault of Zhentil Keep for Teshwave.

The Iron Crisis was an event occurring in 1368 DR in which the Iron Throne plotted to destroy the iron supply of the Sword Coast by poisoning the iron from the mines of Nashkel with alchemy, having groups of bandits steal all of the untainted iron all along the coast and infiltrating rival trading companies with doppelgangers so as to drive them into financial ruin.
In 1368 DR, Atreus Eleint, an acolyte of Sune, quested to retrieve a vial of water from the Fountain of Infinite Grace located within the borders of Langdarma.
The Living Gem War was an internal conflict in the city of Schamedar in southern Calimshan that lasted from Eleasias of 1367 DR to early 1368 DR.

In 1368 DR, a menacing orcish tribe known as the Wolfheads attacked and raided caravans that moved between Milvarune and Thassalra and only caravans that spent extra coins on capable guards managed to reach their destinations.
In 1368 DR, a Mintaran troop on a wide patrol beyond the city-state under the guise of bandits or slavers encountered a small group of Ala-min.
In the Year of the Banner, 1368 DR, the new young Guildmaster of the Shadowmasters – Keshna Finlothleer, led the group into a more aggressive role in Telflamm.

The War of the Shining Crusade was a series of battles fought between the crusaders of Caelar Argent the "Shining Lady", and the Coalition army that comprised soldiers from Waterdeep, Baldur's Gate, and Daggerford.

Zhentil Keep requested help from the Citadel of the Raven to aid them with their defense against the monstrous horde that was en route to their stronghold. Lord Orgauth took over as leader of the stronghold and rallied the Zhentilar army.

With news they would receive to aid from the Citadel, the people trapped within Zhentil Keep run out of food. The white dragons and frost giants allied with Cyric siege the keep during the Night of Crystal and Iron but are kept out by the Zhentilar soldiers.
cites: Ruins of Zhentil Keep: Campaign Book, с. 103

events.text: Iyachtu Xvim is freed from his prison beneath Zhentil Keep, and ascends as a lesser deity. His release repulsed the dragons further north and melted the frozen River Tesh, which drowned the fleeing giants. A few days later, the Godson possessed Fzoul Chembryl and directed him to take control of the Moonsea in his name.

Along with the beholder Manxam, with whom he formed a temporary alliance, Fzoul Chembryl uncovered the alliance between the High Imperceptor of Bane in Mulmaster and another beholder Orox. The forces of each side get into a battle, but neither side claimed victory nor suffered any losses.
The last remnants of the siege of Zhentil Keep were dispersed from the battlefield. However, scores of undead were released from the recently-thawed earth and began to enter into the keep.
The Zhents celebrated the first Victory Day, to commemorate the end of the siege.
Refugees began to return to Zhentil Keep, but only allowed entry provided they swore an oath of loyalty to Lord Orgauth. An envoy from the Citadel of the Raven were turned away.
cites: Ruins of Zhentil Keep: Campaign Book, с. 104

events.text: A plague broke out within Zhentil Keep, likely brought on by the risen undead. After the disease subsided, the arrival of Iyachtu Xvim was announced by his followers within the keep and across Faerûn. Following this, the a delegation from the Citadel of the Raven arrived within the city.
cites: Ruins of Zhentil Keep: Campaign Book, с. 104

events.text: From the safety of the Citadel of the Keep, Manshoon offered a formal apology for abandoning Zhentil Keep along with a contingent of 2000 soldiers to bolster their defenses.
Fzoul Chembryl seized control of the cult of Xvim along with High Priestess Xana the Once Martyred and Casildar.

Khelben "Blackstaff" Arunsun discreetly met with Fzoul in the city of Voonlar and struck a tenuous alliance. Khelben informed Fzoul that Lord Orgauth had been supplanted by the pit fiend Abarax, and Fzoul pledged not to expand the Zhentarim west of the Thunder Peaks for 10,000 days.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition, с. 164

events.text: Nimbaud and Fzoul bound the pit fiend who was impersonating Orgauth, having promised the wizard they would soon inform Manshoon of their discovery. Instead, Fzoul and Abarax slew Nimbaud, established Orgauth/Abarax on the Council of Lords and appointed him as Lord of Zhentil Keep. Nimbaud was replaces by a baatzu, to prevent from disturbing day-to-day operations within the keep.

Fzoul and his forces, aided by Desmonda and the beholder Manxam, attack Mulmaster killing more than half of the city's Cyricists including the High Imperceptor of Cyric. The High Imperceptor of Bane, the former head of the Mulmastran Orthodox church of Bane, was brought back to Zhentil Keep in chains, tortured and imprisoned beneath the Keep at the Heart of the Hand.

links.t: Keep at the Heart of the Hand

events.text: Iyachtu Xvim possessed Fzoul Chembryl and left him with a vision and the task of converting all the remaining Cyricists to Xvimism.

By means of the stone walk spell, Fzoul Chembryl quickly traveled to Mintar in the Lake of Steam and received much fanfare from the city's Banites, who saw him as the avatar of Bane. He permanently branded Teldorn Darkhope with the mark of Xvim, officially converting him to the god's faith.
Teldorn Darkhope announced his full support of Fzoul Chembryl and was rewarded with an appointment as the Lord Knight Imperceptor of Iyachtu Xvim.
Manshoon prepared to retake Zhentil Keep from the newly-ascended Lord Orgauth and restore Zhentarim control to the city.
The Abraxus Affair (also seen as the Abraxus Conspiracy) referred to the attack on King Azoun IV by an abraxus, a magical golden bull-like creature in the Year of the Gauntlet, 1369 DR.
Circa 1369 DR, high priest Delahine Marinus of the Church of the Sacred Sea forged an alliance with Kromes to assault the Kossuthans of Bezantur.
The Deepwater War was a conflict between the ancient wereshark Iakhovas and the city of Waterdeep that took place in 1369 DR.
Halaster's Highharvestide was an event that occurred in Undermountain on Highharvestide in the Year of the Gauntlet, 1369 DR.
In the Year of the Gauntlet, 1369 DR, Queen Brianna fled the pursuit of the superstitious firbolg clans.

The Abraxus Affair takes place: an attempted assassination in which King Azoun IV and his hunting party were attacked by an abraxus. House Bleth is found responsible and is exiled, their lands seized. House Cormaeril is also implicated, losing their lands and titles.
cites: Dungeon 198: Cormyr Royale: The Royal Court of the Forest Kingdom, с. 6

events.text: The Fire Knives assassins guild was refounded in Westgate.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 150

events.text: During the Deepwater War of the Year of the Gauntlet, 1369 DR, an army of sea monsters, led by the wereshark Iakhovas, invaded Waterdeep on Ches 30 via the harbor.
The dracolich Kistarianth was destroyed by Piergeiron the Paladinson on the slopes of Mount Waterdeep during Halaster's Higharvestide.

src.title: History of the Cult of the Dragon

events.text: Kya Mordrayn, the leader of a Cult of the Dragon cell operating in Myth Drannor attempted to use the resurgent Pools of Radiance in her grab for power. Aided by her dracolich ally Pelendralaar, she corrupted a mythal, flooded the ruins of Myth Drannor with undead and her cultists, who were wrapped into reptilian and draconic shapes by the corrupted mythal. The new appearance earned them the name of "scarred ones" among their opponents and "mythal-blessed" among each other. She was defeated by a group of heroes from Phlan sent by Elminster and was dragged away by the fiends as payment for her f
cites: Pool of Radiance: Attack on Myth Drannor, с. 11

src.title: History of the Cult of the Dragon

events.text: Randal Morn and the Freedom Riders liberated Daggerdale from Zhentarim control.
cites: The Return of Randal Morn, с. 26
Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition, с. 126

events.text: Pilgrimages to the moonwells diminished as more Ffolk went missing.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: Robyn and Tristan Kendrick entered the Great Moonwell in Myrloch Vale to investigate the vanishing druids. They ended up in the Feywild.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: The Deepwater War disrupted trade all throughout the Sea of Swords.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 23–31

events.text: Flamerule 6-17: Fzoul infiltrated Mulmaster and set up an alliance with High Blade Selfaril Uoumdolphin of Mulmaster in order to find the locations of the two remaining Imperceptors of Bane. This alliance began the process of bringing Mulmaster and its leader into the Zhentarim.

Fzoul Chembryl returned to the keep in secret and began to take control of the church of Xvim. A gate formed between the Undermountain and Darkhold, and monsters began to pour into vaults beneath the Zhentarim keep. Sememmon, Ashemmi and their forces were held up for three days while they dealt with the invasion.

Nightal 10-26: The possessed Fzoul and Teldorn uncovered the long-lost magic armory beneath Kzelter, retrieved the eleven tyrant blades and forged the Scepter of the Tyrant's Eye. Follwing this quest, Fzoul stone walked to Zhentil Keep, establishing a link between the two realms.
By 1369 DR, the city was firmly under the iron rule of Teldorn Darkhope.
By the end of 1369 DR, Mintar was mustering its forces for an invasion of Kzelter, a small and isolated town at the southern extent of Tethyr's borders.
The Night of Crystal and Iron was a decisive battle during the Fall of Zhentil Keep.
The Night of the Blood Moon was the name given to a bloody assault by Malarite lycanthropes on the city of Loudwater in the Delimbiyr Vale in the Year of the Gauntlet, 1369 DR.
In Year of the Gauntlet, 1369 DR, the dreaded pool of radiance reemerged underneath Valjevo Castle.
In 1369 DR, as Mintar was faced with uprisings and strikes, Saelmar bolstered its defenses.
cites: Perilous Gateways: Portals Under the Black Gauntlet

events.text: In Year of the Gauntlet, 1369 DR, fiends from Hellgate Keep attacked Sundabar, burning much of the city before being forced out.
In the Year of the Gauntlet, 1369 DR an event referred to as the Bhaalspawn crisis broke out in Tethyr.
The Trades Conflagration was a vast and destructive fire that struck the city of Calimport in Calimshan in the late 14th century DR.
The Twelfth Serôs War was a major event in the Sea of Fallen Stars of the 1,439th year of Timesong (1369 DR).
The War of Gold and Gloom was a ongoing war between the gold dwarves from the Great Rift and the gray dwarves from the Underspires over the lost shield dwarf kingdom of Deep Shanatar.
